fullPassage: We're naturally wired to organize the world into a hierarchy. We do this to help make sense of the world, maintain our beliefs, and generally feel better. Or consider when you get frustrated with your kids and end an argument with "Because I said so." In these moments you've stopped thinking and regressed to your biological tendencies of reaffirming the hierarchy. You're reacting to a threat to your inherent sense of hierarchy. On the road we are all equals. We're all supposed to play by the same rules. Cutting someone off violates those rules and implies higher status. But when someone infringes on our place in the world and our understanding of how it works, we react without thinking. When someone cuts you off on the highway and road rage kicks in, that's your unconscious mind saying, "Who are you to cut me off?"

questions.passage: We're naturally wired to organize the world into a hierarchy. We do this to help make sense of the world, maintain our beliefs, and generally feel better. Or consider when you get frustrated with your kids and end an argument with "Because I said so." In these moments you've stopped thinking and regressed to your biological tendencies of reaffirming the hierarchy. You're reacting to a threat to your inherent sense of hierarchy. On the road we are all equals. We're all supposed to play by the same rules. Cutting someone off violates those rules and implies higher status. But when someone infringes on our place in the world and our understanding of how it works, we react without thinking. When someone cuts you off on the highway and road rage kicks in, that's your unconscious mind saying, "<u>Who are you to cut me off</u>?"
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 Who are you to cut me off?가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄의 속뜻: 네가 내 서열(자리)에 도전했다는 무의식적 항의
det.analysis:
밑줄 'Who are you to cut me off?(네가 뭔데 나한테 끼어들어?)'는 단순한 질문이 아니라, 상대가 나의 서열·자리를 침해했다는 무의식적 항의예요. 본문은 이것을 '위계 감각에 대한 위협에 반응하는 것'이라고 설명해요.

✅ ① You have challenged my rightful place in the hierarchy. (너는 위계 속 내 정당한 자리에 도전했다): 밑줄의 속뜻인 '서열 침해에 대한 반응'과 정확히 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ② I am unsure which lane I should use. (어느 차선을 써야 할지 모르겠다): 혼란이 아니라 분노·항의라 맞지 않아요.

❌ ③ I want to apologize for my driving mistake. (내 운전 실수를 사과하고 싶다): 사과가 아니라 상대를 탓하는 반응이에요.

❌ ④ We should both slow down for our safety. (안전을 위해 둘 다 속도를 줄이자): 차분한 제안은 분노 반응과 반대예요.
det.tip: 밑줄 = 서열(위계)이 침해당한 데 대한 무의식적 항의
